references.text: The laws concerning leprosy (tsara'at) that render a person unclean, preventing priests from eating the holy offerings
The purification ritual for the leper, which must be completed before the priest can become clean again
The laws concerning a discharge (zav) from a man, which make him unclean
The laws concerning an emission of semen (shikkvat-zera) that make a man unclean until evening
Rules regarding the holiness and uncleanness of priests in contact with the dead
The immediate context warning priests against profaning the holy offerings
The command to send unclean persons out of the camp, including lepers and those with discharges
Uncleanness through touching a dead body (teme-nefesh) and the purification process
Ezekiel's prophecy concerning priestly purity and uncleanness regarding dead bodies in the future temple
